snippet.title: Aftergods - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Aftergods: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375790

Introducing: Aftergods! Play as a god who survived Ragnarök, rise from the aftermath to form a new pantheon and restore the fallen Seeds of the World Tree. Recruit followers, build temples, and battle giant monsters solo or with friends across a mythical handcrafted open world. Coming to Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S.

Aftergods Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375790
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/aftergods-9044c2
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018645
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/aftergods/9NM9S7HKT5RQ

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
